starter_files.contents:
# Reusable C# Developer Toolkit

Run tests before packing. Keep internal implementation replaceable and avoid exposing implementation-only types publicly.

## Done when

- [ ] Expose a small, well-named public API
- [ ] Use generic constraints only when they express real requirements
- [ ] Test expected behavior and invalid inputs
- [ ] Build and pack repeatably with documentation
